column1: # Supplementary Data 1 (Table S1). Samples, accessions, identity checks and exclusions, one row per sample run (364 rows).

# identity_labelled_fit: share of informative genes (diagnostic coverage >= 10, call set excluding at least one founder) whose founder-diagnostic k-mer call set contains the labelled strain's founder at that gene (Keele kidney, GSE199702; Munger founders: genes whose call set holds at most four founders), or the correlation with the animal's own genotype (Munger DO).

# Mapping columns: kallisto-ref pseudoaligned fraction, STAR unique fraction and hits-per-read ratio (Keele, Munger); Salmon-ref mapping rate (GSE199702). in_compared_sets: the sample is in the sets compared across pipelines. Blank = not measured for that cohort.
